methodology_other: Data were collected from Institut Haïtien de Statistique et d'Informatique, the 2018 Enquête Mortalité, Morbidité et Utilisation des Services (Mortality, Morbidity and Use of Services Survey), and the Haiti Population and Housing Census.
name: haiti-subnational-population-and-housing-data-tables-with-administrative-boundaries
notes:
The geodatabase contains national and subnational boundary feature classes of Haiti for joining (linking) to attribute data provided in tables prepared by the U.S. Census Bureau.

The tabular data contain total population for 2003 (census) and 2015 (population estimates), as well as information relating to education, health, information and communication technology, and transportation.
